_meta.description: Stage 2 (Trained) for the Connected Planning Pre-Sales Foundations journey. Five blocks built around the one-day instructor-led Pre-Sales Workshop (Block B) plus self-paced supporting content. The Pre-Sales Workshop is the centerpiece — it teaches general pre-sales methodology and includes mock presentations for practice with feedback.
_meta._workshop_note: Pre-Sales Workshop is delivered as a one-day instructor-led course, exception to the otherwise self-serve digital Stage 2 model. Mock presentations within the workshop are practice-with-feedback, not the credentialing event — Stage 3 has the rubric-scored mock discovery + certification.
_meta.boundary_with_stage_3: End of Stage 2: PSE has internalized general pre-sales methodology (via the workshop), demo orchestration craft, technical discovery and requirement-mapping fundamentals, and high-level competitive battlecards. Stage 3 is the AI-graded mock discovery + Pre-Sales Foundations certification.

tasks.title: Connected Planning Narrative (Pre-Sales lens)
tasks.description: Webcast deepening the Connected Planning narrative for PSE use — translating buyer outcomes into demo flow choices, proof points to surface during demo, and the multi-application story (how IFP + FCR + AI compose into a Connected Planning enterprise solution architecture).

tasks.title: Pre-Sales Workshop (one-day instructor-led)
tasks.description: Anaplan's existing one-day instructor-led Pre-Sales Workshop. Covers general pre-sales methodology (discovery, demo orchestration, audience management, objection handling) and includes mock presentations within the workshop for practice with instructor feedback. Centerpiece of Pre-Sales Foundations — every PSE attends once.
tasks.estimated_effort: 1 day (~8 hrs incl. mock presentations and feedback)
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: Workshop instructor attests attendance and engagement.

tasks.title: Demo Orchestration Craft
tasks.description: Recording covering universal demo orchestration patterns — opening, pacing, transitions, action-button moments, dealing with mid-demo questions, audience attention management, and recovering from technical hiccups. Generic across applications; per-app demo flow lives in per-app Pre-Sales journeys.

tasks.title: Discovery & Requirement-Mapping Foundations
tasks.description: Guide covering generic technical discovery — how to surface technical signals during a discovery conversation (data shape, integration constraints, planning maturity, performance expectations) and how to map customer requirements to Anaplan capabilities at the platform level. Per-app discovery layers on top in per-app Pre-Sales journeys.

tasks.title: Competitive Battlecard Fundamentals
tasks.description: Walkthrough of the technical-competitive landscape at high level — architectural differentiators (multi-dimensional vs spreadsheet-based, in-memory engine, calculation transparency), planning-maturity differentiators, and integration-pattern differentiators. Per-app technical battlecards in per-app Pre-Sales journeys.
